muxt generate --use-datastar --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /page Page(ctx)" -}}
<button data-on:click="$saving = true; {{ .Actions.Save 7 | .JS }}">save</button>
{{- end -}}
{{- define "POST /save/{id} Save(ctx, id)" -}}ok{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

// Server mixes an action with author-written JS: an action is an expression,
// not a whole attribute, so it composes after the author's statement.
type Server struct{}

func (Server) Page(_ context.Context) (string, error) { return "", nil }

func (Server) Save(_ context.Context, id int) (string, error) { return "", nil }
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/page", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	body := rec.Body.String()
	if want := `data-on:click="$saving = true; @post(&#39;/save/7&#39;)"`; !strings.Contains(body, want) {
		t.Errorf("body = %q, want the author JS untouched with the action after the semicolon: %q", body, want)
	}
}
